title: Undo, in Time and Space
question: What does undo cost in Hazel's editor, in memory and in time, how did we find out, where does the investigation stand, and what is next? Matthew, 2026-11-03, for the meeting with Cyrus on 2026-11-04 (^ticket(665)); he asked for the outline's rebuild, which only the modular editors have, to be separated from the rest.
measurements: Space: ^report(14)'s update (2026-10-14/15), Full Body in a browser, 12 slider edits, live JS heap after two forced GCs; copied in data/space.json. Time: ^report(36)'s probe medians (036/data/steps.json, release build). The outline's part: new, data/outline_split.json, the probe in the dev profile under node --cpu-prof, 2 runs per size, Node 22 on the same laptop (Intel Core i7-1370P, Linux), nice, 64 MB stack under a 256 MB system stack.

builds.what: the probe with the two fixes (^report(36)'s 'after')
the probe with a named sampler per kind (undo apart from redo)
the probe asking for the outline after each step, as the sidebar does (UNDO_VIEW_OUTLINE)
the probe reading each frame's syntax time
the fix: after an undo or redo, RealizeView is an edit only if it changed the program
